newsitem.title: CHILE: Enersis eyes Brazil utility Cemig.
newsitem.headline: Enersis eyes Brazil utility Cemig.

text.p: Chilean power investment company Enersis is interested in bidding for a 33 percent stake to be sold in Brazilian power firm Companhia de Electricidade de Minas Gerais (Cemig), said Enersis chief executive Jose Yuraszeck.
"We are studying Cemig with great attention," Yuraszeck told a news conference.
"It is a very interesting company...what is up for sale is only a percentage which makes the interest in this company different."

Enersis and its distribution unit Chilectra led a consortium including Endesa Espana and Electricidade de Portugal which bought Wednesday a 70 percent stake in Rio de Janeiro utility Cerj for $587 million.
Enersis, which already has projects in Argentina and Peru, could bid for Cemig with these and other partners, he said.
"We have a consortium with these same partners and with other additional partners. But as the group has not yet been formed, we cannot give details," said Yuraszeck.
Minas Gerais state officials have said they hope to start the bidding process for Cemig next month.
